entries.title: Psalms 37:1
segments: ¶<<[A Psalm] of David.>> Fret not thyself because of evildoers, neither be thou envious against the workers of iniquity.

entries.title: Psalms 37:2
segments: For they shall soon be cut down like the grass, and wither as the green herb.

entries.title: Psalms 37:3
segments: Trust in the LORD, and do good; [so] shalt thou dwell in the land, and verily thou shalt be fed. {verily: Heb. in truth, or, stableness}

entries.title: Psalms 37:4
segments: Delight thyself also in the LORD; and he shall give thee the desires of thine heart.

entries.title: Psalms 37:5
segments: Commit thy way unto the LORD; trust also in him; and he shall bring [it] to pass. {Commit...: Heb. Roll thy way upon}

words.text: also in him; and he shall bring [it] to pass

entries.title: Psalms 37:6
segments: And he shall bring forth thy righteousness as the light, and thy judgment as the noonday.

entries.title: Psalms 37:7
segments: ¶Rest in the LORD, and wait patiently for him: fret not thyself because of him who prospereth in his way, because of the man who bringeth wicked devices to pass. {Rest in: Heb. Be silent to}

words.text: not thyself because of him who prospereth

entries.title: Psalms 37:8
segments: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath: fret not thyself in any wise to do evil.

entries.title: Psalms 37:9
segments: For evildoers shall be cut off: but those that wait upon the LORD, they shall inherit the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 37:10
segments: For yet a little while, and the wicked [shall] not [be]: yea, thou shalt diligently consider his place, and it [shall] not [be].

words.text: [shall] not [be]: yea, thou shalt diligently consider

entries.title: Psalms 37:11
segments: But the meek shall inherit the earth; and shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.

entries.title: Psalms 37:12
segments: The wicked plotteth against the just, and gnasheth upon him with his teeth. {plotteth: or, practiseth}

entries.title: Psalms 37:13
segments: The Lord shall laugh at him: for he seeth that his day is coming.

entries.title: Psalms 37:14
segments: The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, to cast down the poor and needy, [and] to slay such as be of upright conversation. {such...: Heb. the upright of way}

entries.title: Psalms 37:15
segments: Their sword shall enter into their own heart, and their bows shall be broken.

entries.title: Psalms 37:16
segments: A little that a righteous man hath [is] better than the riches of many wicked.

entries.title: Psalms 37:17
segments: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken: but the LORD upholdeth the righteous.

entries.title: Psalms 37:18
segments: The LORD knoweth the days of the upright: and their inheritance shall be for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 37:19
segments: They shall not be ashamed in the evil time: and in the days of famine they shall be satisfied.

entries.title: Psalms 37:20
segments: But the wicked shall perish, and the enemies of the LORD [shall be] as the fat of lambs: they shall consume; into smoke shall they consume away. {the fat: Heb. the preciousness}

entries.title: Psalms 37:21
segments: ¶The wicked borroweth, and payeth not again: but the righteous sheweth mercy, and giveth.

entries.title: Psalms 37:22
segments: For [such as be] blessed of him shall inherit the earth; and [they that be] cursed of him shall be cut off.

words.text: of him shall be cut off

entries.title: Psalms 37:23
segments: The steps of a [good] man are ordered by the LORD: and he delighteth in his way. {ordered: or, established}

entries.title: Psalms 37:24
segments: Though he fall, he shall not be utterly cast down: for the LORD upholdeth [him with] his hand.

words.text: , he shall not be utterly cast down

entries.title: Psalms 37:25
segments: I have been young, and [now] am old; yet have I not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his seed begging bread.

entries.title: Psalms 37:26
segments: [He is] ever merciful, and lendeth; and his seed [is] blessed. {ever: Heb. all the day}

entries.title: Psalms 37:27
segments: Depart from evil, and do good; and dwell for evermore.

entries.title: Psalms 37:28
segments: For the LORD loveth judgment, and forsaketh not his saints; they are preserved for ever: but the seed of the wicked shall be cut off.

entries.title: Psalms 37:29
segments: The righteous shall inherit the land, and dwell therein for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 37:30
segments: The mouth of the righteous speaketh wisdom, and his tongue talketh of judgment.

entries.title: Psalms 37:31
segments: The law of his God [is] in his heart; none of his steps shall slide. {steps: or, goings}

entries.title: Psalms 37:32
segments: The wicked watcheth the righteous, and seeketh to slay him.

entries.title: Psalms 37:33
segments: The LORD will not leave him in his hand, nor condemn him when he is judged.

entries.title: Psalms 37:34
segments: ¶Wait on the LORD, and keep his way, and he shall exalt thee to inherit the land: when the wicked are cut off, thou shalt see [it].

entries.title: Psalms 37:35
segments: I have seen the wicked in great power, and spreading himself like a green bay tree. {a green...: or, a green tree that groweth in his own soil}

words.text: . {a green...: or, a green tree that groweth in his own soil}

entries.title: Psalms 37:36
segments: Yet he passed away, and, lo, he [was] not: yea, I sought him, but he could not be found.

words.text: , and, lo, he [was] not: yea, I sought
him, but he could not be found

entries.title: Psalms 37:37
segments: Mark the perfect [man], and behold the upright: for the end of [that] man [is] peace.

entries.title: Psalms 37:38
segments: But the transgressors shall be destroyed together: the end of the wicked shall be cut off.

entries.title: Psalms 37:39
segments: But the salvation of the righteous [is] of the LORD: [he is] their strength in the time of trouble.

entries.title: Psalms 37:40
segments: And the LORD shall help them, and deliver them: he shall deliver them from the wicked, and save them, because they trust in him.
